text:
incident-bot: PAGER DUTY ALERT: inference-gateway-prod — spike in HTTP 5xx rate (eu-west1). Threshold breached: 5xx > 3% for 2m. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC12345

oncall-eu1-maya: acked — I'm on it, looking at front proxy metrics :eyes:

mike: thanks. can you confirm if that's regional or global?

sarah: early look: errors originated from sidecar proxy (envoy) returning 502s, tail of logs shows upstream connect failures.

sarah: snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T01:07:12Z] proxy:error upstream reset: connect_timeout
[2026-03-16T01:07:12Z] request_id=abcd-1234 status=502 route=/v1/generate
```

ops-bot: Autoscale check: no recent scale events. Pool utilization: GPU nodes 78%, sidecar CPU 92% in eu-west1-a

mike: sounds like sidecar CPU saturation. Any traffic skew (large batch jobs)?

sarah: traffic profile shows short burst of long-context requests from partner X starting ~01:05Z. Batching increased CPU on sidecars.

oncall-eu1-maya: mitigations in progress: 1) temporarily lower max_batch_size to 64 for gateway; 2) route 10% traffic to fallback model-quant to relieve load. Applying now.

pagerduty: Escalation scheduled in 5m if no ack from secondary — secondary oncall lexi.

lexi: I'm up as backup, will pick up at handoff. if maya needs to rotate please ping me :handshake:

sarah: change applied: max_batch_size=64 -> reduced. KV cache warmup paused. early signs: 5xx rate down to 1.4% over last 90s :thumbsup:

mike: please keep monitoring. if 5xx < 2% for 10m we can close PD alert and file postmortem. Otherwise prepare for node reprovisioning.

oncall-eu1-maya: routing rollback ready in case of regress. i'll update pd with status.

incident-bot: PD incident INC12345 status: acknowledged -> mitigation underway. Monitor window open.

sarah: tagging customer-impact: small subset of requests from partner X saw errors; no broad customer outage detected. logging ticket filed: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/789

lexi: noted, I'll join the postmortem if needed. Great teamwork :clap:

ops-bot: last check: 5xx rate 0.9%, sidecar CPU 66%. closing monitoring window at +12m if stable.

mike: closing oncall loop, handoff to lexi at shift change.

oncall-eu1-maya: handoff complete, transferring context to lexi.

incident-bot: PD incident INC12345 resolved (auto-resolve): reason=stabilized. :white_check_mark:
